notes.title: TIC-TAC: Twelve o'clock exclusive Demo Update for Ukrainian Game Festival!
notes.content:
Hello Gamers!

We’ve prepared an exclusive Demo update!
Why is it worth your attention - a full episode of the story-rich horror survival with “FNAF” vibe.
Approximate gameplay time: 25 - 30 min

Wishlist on Steam and Follow us on X/Twitter! This is the best way to support our game.
